symbols.name: packing base
symbols.meaning: The base 2^{4p} at which the polynomials are evaluated.

symbols.name: signed evaluation integer
symbols.meaning: The integer obtained by evaluating the integer-coefficient polynomial u at B_0.
symbols.quote: let $A_u=u(B_0)=\sum_{j<r}u_jB_0^j$ be the signed evaluation integer

symbols.name: carry
symbols.meaning: The carry, in {-1,0}, into block j when forming A_u.
symbols.quote: scan the coefficients with a carry $\gamma_j$

symbols.name: block
symbols.meaning: The residue of u_j plus the carry modulo B_0, the j-th block of 4p bits of A_u.
symbols.quote: Let $d_j\in[0,B_0)$ be the residue of $u_j+\gamma_j$ modulo $B_0$

symbols.name: product coefficient
symbols.meaning: The coefficient of y^j in the ordinary product h=ac of integer polynomials.

symbols.name: extraction carry
symbols.meaning: The carry into block j during extraction, in {0,1}.
symbols.quote: let $\rho_j$ be the carry into block $j$

symbols.name: reduced coefficient
symbols.meaning: The Gaussian integer coefficient of y^j after reduction modulo y^r+1.
symbols.quote: Let $H_j$ be the resulting Gaussian integer coefficient.

relations.quote: It multiplies in the [Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1](ring-y.md) in $O(rp\log(rp))$ time, where $p$ is the number of fractional bits of each coefficient.

The multiplier takes nonnegative integers, so signed packing multiplies the four pairs of absolute values with the [Established O(n log n) multiplier](hvdh-multiplier.md), restoring each sign, to obtain $A_aA_c,A_bA_e,A_aA_e,A_bA_c$.

derivations.quote: Write $f=2^{-p}(a+ib)$ and $g=2^{-p}(c+ie)$, where $a,b,c,e$ (letters that change meaning here) are integer-coefficient polynomials of degree below $r$ with coefficients of absolute value at most $2^p$. Set $B_0=2^{4p}$, the packing base.
By the geometric sum, $|A_u|\le2^p(B_0^r-1)/(B_0-1)<B_0^r/2$, so its magnitude fits in $4pr$ bits.

The multiplier takes nonnegative integers, so signed packing multiplies the four pairs of absolute values with the [Established O(n log n) multiplier](hvdh-multiplier.md), restoring each sign, to obtain $A_aA_c,A_bA_e,A_aA_e,A_bA_c$. A product is negative when exactly one operand is.

Each $h_j$ sums at most $r$ products of coefficients of size at most $2^p$, so $|h_j|\le r2^{2p}<2^{3p}<B_0/2$. So after removing lower coefficients, the next is identified by its centered residue modulo $B_0$

Since $-B_0<u_j+\gamma_j<B_0$ whenever $\gamma_j\in\{-1,0\}$, the carry stays in $\{-1,0\}$. Telescoping gives $A_u=\sum_{j<r}d_jB_0^j+\gamma_rB_0^r$, so the blocks $d_j$ are a fixed-width two's-complement encoding of $A_u$.
If $\widehat h_i=h_i$ for $i<j$, then $\sum_{i<j}q_iB_0^i=\sum_{i<j}h_iB_0^i+\rho_jB_0^j$, so $q_j+\rho_j\equiv h_j$ modulo $B_0$. Since $h_j\in[-B_0/2,B_0/2)$, $\widehat h_j=h_j$.
The real and imaginary numerator streams are $ac-be$ and $ae+bc$. Since $y^{j+r}=-y^j$, reduce modulo $y^r+1$ by subtracting the coefficient at $j+r$ from the one at $j$ for $0\le j<r$.
So $H_j$ is a sum of exactly $r$ signed products of coefficients of modulus at most $2^p$, hence $|H_j|\le r2^{2p}$.
Four exact integer products therefore dominate the linear packing, extraction, combination, wrapping and truncation costs, so the total is $O(rp\log(rp))$
